allowed_dsps.description: The DSPs that may receive the deal (§ 5.8), each by its primary domain, as `SeatRef.dsp` (§ 2.2)

seat_owner.description: The legal entity that owns the seats. Absent: the `buyer`

seats.description: The buyer's seats on the deal, as the Deals API 1.0 `wseat`

seats_expected.description: The seller asks the buyer to supply `seats`

delivery_type.description: What the seller promises under this mechanism. The value on the mechanism in effect (§ 3.1) applies to the line item

id.description: The mechanism, which is the option id (§ 3.1)

RetentionRange.description: A range of values from `min` to `max`, with at least one bound, such as the time an ad stays in the content the seller distributes.

TransactionMechanismSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

description: The OpenProposal `execution` module: the vocabularies, objects, unions, and constructor copies of § 5.9.
